name: Chen Lijun
bio: Chen Lijun is a Yue Opera actor who received widespread attention for playing the villain Jia Ting in the New Dragon Inn 2023 Yue Opera. In 2024 Chen Lijun participated in Ride the Wind 2024 as the first professional opera actor to do so in the show.
